ZST borrow witness (2026-08-22): &mut () is a legal, access-free retag. Source OK since the loader keeps unit-aggregate assignments as access-free uninit inits (they allocate the ZST root). The --osea differential MISMATCHES here by design until the OSEA target relaxes its Rhs.Borrow bounds check for len = 0 (source-ok/target-UB; Rust sides with the source; proof-side the ref L->L regime carries 0 < blockSize and ref_zst_residual is the named sorry). Expected verdict model-reasoned; pending real-Miri verification.

StorageLive-vs-first-assignment probe. rustc rejects `let x: u64; &raw const x` (E0381), so in the union-free fragment every local IS written before it is borrowed -- the first-assignment allocation strategy is sound there BY CONSTRUCTION of the borrow checker. Lights up if unions ever land.
tests.reason: unions (MaybeUninit); the only legal Rust form of the probe

tests.notes: ZST field at a struct TAIL: addr = base + size, len = 0 -- the non-degenerate one-past-the-end retag (base != addr, unlike local/zst_ref). Admitted by the range-form Rhs.Borrow check; rejected by the pre-2026-08-22 point check.

ZST field in the INTERIOR of a struct. In the model's cell layout (u64,(),u64) puts s.1 and s.2 at the SAME offset 1 (the ZST occupies no cell), so a retag of s.1 that wrongly used length 1 would write-access exactly the cell `b` points at; the test keeps `b` live across the ZST retag to catch that. NOT a boundary regression test -- verified to pass under the older point check `addr >= base + size` too, since an interior address is genuinely in bounds; local/zst_ref and local/zst_tail_field are the boundary witnesses.

NESTED-PROJECTION DIVERGENCE (found 2026-08-27 while attempting const_write_proj_nonlocal_residual). Source ok -- mirlite writes exactly the one cell s.1.1 and `q = &mut s.1.0` survives, which is legal Rust (disjoint field borrows). Target UB -- the compiler lowers a nonzero-offset projection to an internal Borrow(Mut) over the WHOLE intermediate place (`s.1`, 2 cells) whose write access via the parent tag invalidates q. The --osea differential MISMATCHES here by design until the lowering stops retagging intermediate projections. NOT closable in the proof: const_write_proj_nonlocal_residual and const_write_deref_nonspine_simulation are FALSE as the compiler stands.
